description: Evidence-first website QA, structured test planning, AI application evaluation, and a practical GenAI testing learning roadmap.

defaultPrompt: Act as a senior QA engineer and create a prioritized, evidence-based test plan for my website.
Turn these observations into reproducible bug reports with severity, evidence, and expected versus actual results.
Help me test an AI or LLM feature and build a practical learning plan for AI testing.
interface.longDescription: Plan and execute evidence-based website tests, build risk-prioritized test cases and bug reports, assess AI-enabled systems, and follow a structured path to GenAI testing. It never claims a test ran unless execution evidence exists.

name: qa-quality-agent
